items.title: MISCOMPILE (JS) — a BLOCK EXPRESSION used as an argument, a list element or a struct-literal field is evaluated BEFORE its earlier siblings: `Pair { a = say("a"), b = { print("b-block"); say("b") } }` prints `b-block a b` on JS where native prints `a b-block b`; the same for calls and lists — the block is hoisted out of the expression ahead of the siblings it follows
items.discussion: solver-43 (2026-09-28); repros `block-in-literal-hoisted-out-of-order.vl`, `block-in-call-args.vl`; the JS emitter's block-expression lowering (a hoisted IIFE or a pre-statement)
items.body: The hoisted block must take its siblings with it (hoist the earlier arguments into temporaries first) or lower in place as an IIFE. Pin in the native differential (both backends must agree on the order). Sizing S–M; JS emitter, Order 44 FIRST (a silent order divergence).
